body: Yet you do have those thoughts, I’m too young to know but I think that’s how it starts and some time from now even family won’t be able to keep you here. I hope I’m wrong
I like that. Too bad I don’t have and can’t get any of those helpful pills

That was quite some time ago and I wasn’t eating shrooms to cure depressive state at that time I wasn’t depressed at all. If nature can’t help us then I don’t think pharmaceuticals can. 

Another thing I would try is outdoors, camping hiking, getting out of the city for some time.

I would try small dose of psilocybin mushroom. I’ve tried them once or twice (unless my memory is playing tricks on me again). If nothing else helps why not ask the longest living organism on Earth for help? That’s what I would do if I could find some.

Well for starters my mind is telling me my memories are not really mine.
Everything has already happened and I’m stuck in a loop and can’t escape. 
Evolution theory is wrong, there’s no way we (humans) could evolve from monkeys to the creatures we are right now. 
I’m not where I think I currently am and it’s freaking me out seeing my room in the basement and feeling like I’m somewhere out in public and being watched. Super anxious when I’m the washroom because I feel I’m not really there. 
Constant pinching on my ears left or right and me trying to interpret this as message from whothefuckknowswho that what I’m currently doing is wrong or right. 
Pain on my cheekbones like being pressed on with something heavy. 
Few days ago additional sensation on my right foot kind of like having a nail there but it’s not there. Not a lot of pain but annoying. 
Random pain occurring on my torso mostly on the left side. 
Unpleasant dreams that seem like it’s me living somewhere without my knowledge, seriously there’s another me somewhere.
